messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval alert • 2024-03-12 04:12 UTC — 14/200 promptsets failing vs baseline (rdm-v2-int4). Top signal: instruction-following drop on 'billing_faqs' cohort. https://console.redwood.ai/eval/1721123456 :warning:
priya: ugh, saw this in my inbox. failures concentrated on short-fewshot prompts, answers get truncated or repeat 'Sorry' lines.
matt: can you paste one of the failing examples?
priya: here — run output (trimmed):
```
Prompt: "How do I cancel my subscription?
Examples: [..fewshot..]
Model (rdm-v2-int4): "You can cancel via the dashboard. Sorry, I can't help with that. Sorry, I can't help with that."
Baseline (rdm-v2-fp16): "Go to Settings → Billing → Cancel subscription. Confirming will stop future charges."
```
ken: interesting — repeated 'Sorry' looks like an early token-level collapse / kvcache reuse bug. only repros on int4 quant path, int8 and fp16 look fine.
julia: initial severity = P2 (user-visible but limited cohort). affects billing_faqs + 2 other small cohorts.
priya: I'm going to run a focused repro on staging with --seed=42, batch=1, kvcache=on/off to isolate. assigning owners: runtime=ken, eval=priya.
matt: tagging ops in case we need a quick rollback: @ops-jen if we decide to fallback to rdm-v2-fp16 can you prep a canary?
ops-jen: got it — I can stage a rollback canary to route 5% traffic to rdm-v2-fp16 in the next 30m if needed. need approval.
ken: quick triage notes: 1) compare KV cache keys for identical prompts between int4 and fp16 2) run nightly with KV flush on 3) check compiled kernel selection logs for mixed precision path. I'll post logs in this thread.
priya: repro command I'm running:
```bash
./eval_runner --suite billing_faqs --model rdm-v2-int4 --seed 42 --batch 1 --kvcache on --output /tmp/repro.log
```
matt: +1 to kvcache flush test. if repro holds up, we should block the int4 rollout.
julia: owner ship: Ken -> runtime debug, Priya -> confirm eval thresholds and produce minimal failing promptset, Matt -> decide gating for rollout pause, Ops-Jen -> prepare fallback. timeline: aim to have first repro & logs in 45m.
ken: copying initial kernel log snippet: `kernel_select: quant_int4_path selected, fused_attention_v2, seq_len=64, tile=32` — looking for mismatch against fp16 path.
priya: I pulled three failing prompts, pushing to /tmp/billing_fails_1721123456.json and to the eval dashboard. link: https://console.redwood.ai/eval/1721123456/fails
matt: thanks. if anyone sees >20% degradation on any customer-facing cohort we trigger emergency rollback.
ops-jen: noted. I'll standby and prep canary job.
priya: quick note — no upstream infra deploys in the window, so likely model or quantization issue.
ken: agreed. next steps: repro -> kernel/log diff -> if repro consistent, create hotfix branch (revert quant schedule or disable optimized fused attention) and run targeted nightlies.
julia: logging the triage in the incident tracker and assigning follow-up tasks. will update this thread once we have repro confirmation. :white_check_mark:
matt: thanks team — keep updates here. :eyes:
